question: Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal target land containing both Dahan and Invaders. May Bringer first draw and inspect the four Major Power Cards from the first option, then decide to take the other option’s 2 Fear instead, or must the ~or~ option be chosen before either option begins resolving?
answer: The option must be chosen before either option begins resolving. Bringer cannot inspect the Major Power draw and then switch to the 2 Fear option. If the Major-gain option is chosen, resolve that option, including the ordinary draw-four/keep-one and Major Forgetting requirement; drawing the cards is already resolving that option.

Both use Call on Midnight’s Dream after the Major-gain branch has been selected; they test Forgetting/Repeat rules and later-entering Repeat eligibility, respectively. Neither asks branch-choice timing.
